order_multi_level_view.problem: Ops/admin (and each actor) need to see one order from different levels: what corporate sees, what kitchen sees, what rider sees, plus Middo money/ops truth.

today.admin_ops: Shared OrderShow — staff 360 with links out to corporate/kitchen/rider *profiles*, not their order experience
today.corporate: List/cards + API track/support — no shared OrderShow; limited status narrative via CorporateApiPresenter
today.kitchen: ActiveOrders / group tables + dispatch modal — no dedicated order detail page
today.delivery: KitchenDispatches / DeliveredOrders / PaymentModal — action lists, no dedicated order detail page

desired.summary: One order, multiple lenses. From ops/admin OrderShow (or equivalent), switch perspective without leaving the order.

lenses.shows: Full truth: parties, group, status/payment, money tree, payables, logs, box custody, complaints, force tools
Buyer-facing: menu/qty/when/where, payment, track timeline, support thread, cancel/edit eligibility — hide Middo P&L / partner shares
Cook/dispatch-facing: group mates, accept/ready/pack/dispatch state, deadline, boxes assigned, kitchen share/cash context — hide corporate wallet internals
Run-facing: pickup→drop, COD collection / Due / commission, empty-box return, handover state — hide kitchen capacity / Middo rest

design_notes: Prefer one Order resource + lens tabs/query (?lens=corporate|kitchen|rider|middo) over four divergent pages that drift
Native role pages should reuse the same lens components so ops preview matches reality
AuthZ: ops/admin can open any lens; corporate/kitchen/rider only their own + scoped to their order
Deep-link from lists, alerts, complaints, money events into OrderShow with the right default lens
Overlaps O-ORDER force tools and parked rider who-holds-what — lens view is read/context; mutations stay role-gated
open_questions: Is ops preview read-only always, or can ops act while viewing a lens (e.g. reassign from rider lens)?
Include package-subscription / custom-run contexts as additional lenses later?
Corporate web vs mobile API — same presenter contract for lens parity?
